quality.presetLightCaption: Takes little space. Perfect for quick sharing or uploads.
quality.presetBalancedCaption: The best balance of sharpness and size. Great for almost everything.
quality.presetMaxCaption: The sharpest, smoothest result. Built for editing or presenting.
quality.presetCustomCaption: Tune each control to taste. File size is computed live.
quality.infoResolution: Pixel count: higher looks sharper but weighs more. 1080p is ideal for almost everything. It never exceeds your screen's real resolution.
quality.infoFps: Frames per second: more fps make motion smoother and increase size. 30 is perfect for screen recording; 60 for fast motion.
quality.infoBitrate: Data per second: this affects file size the most. Higher = cleaner image; lower = light file that can pixelate in motion-heavy scenes.

landing.heroSubtitle: Kaipu Record captures your screen and camera in high quality, right on your Mac. Private, fast, and account-free.
landing.showcaseHeading: Everything you need to record and share
landing.showRecordBody: Screen and floating camera in one take, ready for tutorials and demos. Start with a shortcut — no setup.
landing.showShotBody: Take a screenshot, crop it, mark it up with arrows and boxes, and hide sensitive parts with a blur. All in seconds.
landing.showEditBody: Trim the extra, add notes and slides, and export a share-ready MP4.
landing.whyHeading: Built to be fast and frictionless
landing.featureGalleryBody: Recordings and screenshots organized in one place, with search and re-editing whenever you want.
landing.featurePrivateBody: Everything is processed and stored on your machine. Nothing leaves for the cloud unless you want it to.
landing.featureNoAccountBody: No sign-ups, no logins. Download and record.
landing.featureQualityBody: Pick resolution, smoothness, and file size with clear presets — from light to maximum quality.
landing.featureShortcutsBody: Start, stop, and bring the app to the front from anywhere with rebindable shortcuts.
landing.downloadSubtitle: Free for macOS 11+. Windows coming soon.
